content: Experimental results are shown in Table TABREF28. For the baselines, the best scores reported in each original paper are shown. MPAD reaches best performance on 7 out of 10 datasets, and is close second elsewhere. Moreover, the 7 datasets on which MPAD ranks first widely differ in training set size, number of categories, and prediction task (topic, sentiment, subjectivity), which indicates that MPAD can perform well in different settings.
